overview.description: The WisdomTree Space Economy Fund (WSPC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund is an actively managed fund of global equities that span across the full space economy value chain. The fund aims to provide exposure to commercial technology, defense procurement, and sovereign infrastructure investments WSPC was launched on Jul 9, 2026 and is issued by WisdomTree.

data.title: WisdomTree Launches Space Economy Fund (WSPC)
data.text: NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--WisdomTree today announced the launch of the WisdomTree Space Economy Fund (WSPC).

holdings.infoBox: WSPC is an equity ETF with a total of 60 individual holdings. The top holdings are Space Exploration Technologies stock at 15.10%, Rocket Lab at 5.65%, Firefly Aerospace at 4.24%, Intuitive Machines at 3.73%, and Redwire at 3.43%.
